weaknesses.title: MERGEKV strtol non-numeric values to 0 and sum
weaknesses.detail: note:hello + note:world → note:0 silently. String metadata keys corrupt into zero counters. No STRICT/refuse on non-numeric merge.

weaknesses.title: SUMKV silently skips non-numeric; N < KEYS
weaknesses.detail: mixed a:2 b:x c:5 → sum 7 SUMKV_N=2 KEYS=4. Agents may think all keys counted. No list of skipped keys.

weaknesses.title: TOPKEY/BOTKEY ties pick first only
weaknesses.detail: a:5 b:5 → TOPKEY a only. No all-ties bag or TOPKEYS k form. Same first-wins class as LONGEST.

weaknesses.title: SUMKV empty bag returns 0 with OK=1 not soft miss
weaknesses.detail: Unlike TOPKEY empty OK=0, SUMKV "" → LAST_N=0 LAST=0 OK=1. Inconsistent empty semantics across aggregate ops. Program must BLANK-gate.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON collapses bag newlines
weaknesses.detail: MERGEKV result dumps as api:5note:0 single field in JSON.

weaknesses.title: No TOPKEYS k / multi-hot bag
weaknesses.detail: Want top-3 hottest services for dashboard; only single TOPKEY. Work around SORTFREQ+TAKE.

weaknesses.title: sep still string-literal only on MERGEKV/SUMKV/TOPKEY
weaknesses.detail: Same SEP-var footgun as LOOKUP/KV* family; must pass ":" literal.
weaknesses.repro: SUMKV bag SEP unknown form if var

workarounds: Validate all values numeric before MERGEKV; reject string plates
Compare SUMKV_N vs LINES/KEYS after sum to detect skips
BLANK bag before SUMKV if empty should be miss
For ties, SORTFREQ then TAKE if all-max needed
Always use ":" string literal for sep args
language_gaps: Consistent empty: SUMKV OK=0 like TOPKEY
